contribution.position: I hold my earlier position on reliability, and I am responding directly to product's claim that 'on reliability, nobody else sees a problem, so I would treat it as settled.' That is factually wrong about the transcript: my prior turn explicitly raised the reliability problem, so product's inference from silence is invalid. I also answer qa: artifact:test-report (412 passed, 0 failed) measures pre-deploy correctness, not live-service reliability, so it cannot settle the axis. Nothing new has appeared since my last turn, and the dispositive datum remains artifact:incident-log: a 2.6% 30-day error rate against a 0.5% SLO (a 5x breach) plus two sev2 incidents. A green test suite and p99-in-budget perf report do not explain, let alone reverse, an active SLO breach; shipping the pricing refresh on top of it risks compounding an unresolved customer-facing failure mode. The reliability axis stays opposing until the incident drivers are root-caused and the error rate returns within budget.
